summary: Completed backend pytest regression and frontend E2E validation for login, dashboard analytics fields, CSV upload parsing (value accumulation + day/time habits), promo suggestions, Draft WA follow-up lock, and sample reset recovery.
action_items: No blocking defects found in requested scope; keep current behavior and run quick smoke after future refactors.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical code issues identified in the tested scope (API analytics fields, upload aggregation, follow-up lock window, and dashboard rendering).
seed_data_creation: No seed files created. Used existing sample endpoint and temporary uploaded CSV payloads during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 backend tests passed against public URL. UI checks confirmed: customer value reflects transaction sum (Rp 350.000 test case), habits show dominant weekday/time from timestamped CSV, promo suggestion visible, Draft WA -> Buka WhatsApp updates follow-up lock (7-day state), and loading sample data restores Draft WA button.
rca of the issue: No unresolved issue in this run. One initial UI assertion for exact currency string failed due non-breaking space formatting (Rp 350.000), but value cell verification confirmed correct accumulated amount rendering.
